pages.text: Snow fell softly outside. Grandpa took cookies from the oven. Ginger filled the kitchen with its smell.
Nils wanted cookies that crunched with every bite. "I'll eat them warm!"
Grandpa put them on a wide wooden board. Steam rose.
Nils picked one up. Still soft. It broke in half between his fingers.
The broken piece fell to the floor. He stared at it.
He took another. This one crumbled completely. Only crumbs filled his palm.
Only a few whole cookies remained. Crumbs scattered on the floor. Nils still hadn't heard a crunch.
Grandpa held his palm over the board. Still warm. He moved it to the window.
Nils waited with his chin in his hands. Snow piled softly outside. The cookies stopped steaming.
He picked up a cookie and bit. Crunch. Crunch. His eyes grew round.
